purpose: Describe candidate gameplay frames: game state, visible action, HUD text and anything unusual. Supporting evidence for game-event detection (SPEC 15, 21, 26), never a decision on its own.

game.description: Game profile id, or 'an unidentified game' when unknown (SPEC 23).

frame_count.description: How many frames accompany this prompt. Bounded by analysis.vision.max_frames_per_request.

timestamps.description: Human-readable source timestamps, one per frame, in order.

description.description: What is visible in this frame.

labels.description: Short lowercase tags justified by the image.

hud.description: HUD text read verbatim, keyed by field name. Omitted fields are fields that were not legible.
